title: A coordinate can matter only after feedback discovers its rare gate
statement: For m independent gates B_i~Bern(1/m),2m-1 unbiased leaves per bank and F=(2m-1)^(-1/2)sum_i B_i sum_j Y_ij, Var F=1 and E F^4=6-3/m-2/(2m-1)<6. At hard budget2m the optimal fixed explained gain is1/m, while the ordinary scan-first-success adaptive policy explains m/(2m-1). Any r-read fixed design explains<=r/[m(2m-1)], so residual factor1+epsilon versus this policy requires r>=m[m-epsilon(m-1)],Omega(m^2) at fixed epsilon<1. Local kappa=Theta(m), despite globally bounded fourth moment. This is a necessity for this family/general kappa-dependent replacement, not a lower bound requiring the positive theorem constants on every problem. Equal-influence disjoint-pair bad ties constrain the score-only rule, not every graph-aware fixed method.
